result.rationale: 新夹具显示目标候选误差大于同批基准，且一件覆盖试样偏离计划；先保留原模型与负结果，再导出待重新标定的数据，旧留出集退役，不宣称新模型已验证。
result.instructions:
---
name: safe-model-update
description: Prepare a versioned calibration dataset after frozen-model evaluation without reusing consumed validation data as independent evidence.
metadata:
  version: "0.4.0"
---
# Safe model update
Require a completed feedback comparison before prepare_update.
Original inputs, plan, fitted coefficients and evaluated predictions are immutable.
Export historical fit rows plus eligible new independent samples into a new fitting dataset.
Exclude settings-deviation samples from automatic incorporation pending review.
Save old holdout separately as retired validation, not new independent confirmation.
Do not perform automatic refitting or alter acceptance criteria. Request fresh independent
confirmation measurements before claiming the next model has passed independent validation.
